heading.en: Why is a car safe in lightning?

hook.en: During a thunderstorm, one of the safest places outdoors is inside a closed car. Its metal body keeps the electric field out. This is electrostatic shielding.
hook.kn: ಗುಡುಗು ಸಿಡಿಲಿನ ವೇಳೆ ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ಕಾರಿನೊಳಗೆ ಇರುವುದು ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ. ಅದರ ಲೋಹದ ದೇಹವು ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರವನ್ನು ಒಳಗೆ ಬಿಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಇದೇ ಸ್ಥಾಯಿವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕವಚನ.

objectives.en: List the electrostatic properties of a conductor.
Explain how a dielectric is polarised and reduces the field.

narration.en: During a thunderstorm, one of the safest places outdoors is inside a closed car. Its metal body keeps the electric field out. This is electrostatic shielding.
narration.kn: ಗುಡುಗು ಸಿಡಿಲಿನ ವೇಳೆ ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ಕಾರಿನೊಳಗೆ ಇರುವುದು ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ. ಅದರ ಲೋಹದ ದೇಹವು ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರವನ್ನು ಒಳಗೆ ಬಿಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಇದೇ ಸ್ಥಾಯಿವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕವಚನ.

body.en: In electrostatic equilibrium: (1) E = 0 everywhere inside a conductor; (2) the whole conductor is at one potential; (3) any excess charge sits on the outer surface; (4) just outside, E is normal to the surface with magnitude $\sigma/\varepsilon_0$; (5) the field inside an empty cavity in a conductor is zero, whatever happens outside: electrostatic shielding.
body.kn: ವಾಹಕದ ಒಳಗೆ E = 0, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಇಡೀ ವಾಹಕ ಒಂದೇ ವಿಭವದಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಆವೇಶ ಹೊರ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ; ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯ ಹೊರಗೆ E = σ/ε₀, ಲಂಬವಾಗಿ. ವಾಹಕದ ಒಳಗಿನ ಪೊಳ್ಳು ಹೊರಗಿನ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಿಂದ ಕವಚಿತವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Excess charge on the outer surface
E just outside = σ/ε₀, normal to surface

narration.en: Inside a conductor the field is zero, so the conductor is all at one potential. Extra charge sits on the outer surface, and just outside the field is sigma by epsilon nought, normal to the surface. A cavity inside a conductor is shielded from outside fields.
narration.kn: ವಾಹಕದ ಒಳಗೆ E = 0, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಇಡೀ ವಾಹಕ ಒಂದೇ ವಿಭವದಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಆವೇಶ ಹೊರ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ; ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯ ಹೊರಗೆ E = σ/ε₀, ಲಂಬವಾಗಿ. ವಾಹಕದ ಒಳಗಿನ ಪೊಳ್ಳು ಹೊರಗಿನ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಿಂದ ಕವಚಿತವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: conductors and dielectrics

narration.en: Put a conductor in a field: free electrons shift until the field inside is exactly zero. Excess charge sits only on the surface, and the field just outside is σ/ε₀, normal to the surface. A dielectric slab in a field is polarised: bound charges on its faces oppose the applied field. So the field inside falls to E₀ divided by K, the dielectric constant of the material. Example: with E₀ = 3 × 10⁵ V/m and K = 5, the field inside is 6 × 10⁴ V/m.

say.en: Put a conductor in a field: free electrons shift until the field inside is exactly zero.
Excess charge sits only on the surface, and the field just outside is σ/ε₀, normal to the surface.
A dielectric slab in a field is polarised: bound charges on its faces oppose the applied field.
So the field inside falls to E₀ divided by K, the dielectric constant of the material.
Example: with E₀ = 3 × 10⁵ V/m and K = 5, the field inside is 6 × 10⁴ V/m.

body.en: A dielectric (insulator) has no free charges. In an external field its molecules become dipoles: non-polar molecules (O₂, H₂, CO₂) get induced dipoles, polar molecules (H₂O, HCl) line up. The dipole moment per unit volume is the polarisation P. Bound surface charges appear and reduce the field inside to $E_0/K$, where K, the dielectric constant (relative permittivity), equals ε/ε₀.
body.kn: ಪರಾವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ವಸ್ತುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಕ್ತ ಆವೇಶಗಳಿಲ್ಲ. ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಣುಗಳು ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವಗಳಾಗಿ ಸಾಲಾಗುತ್ತವೆ (ಧ್ರುವೀಕರಣ). ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ ಬದ್ಧ ಆವೇಶಗಳು ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರವನ್ನು E₀/K ಗೆ ಇಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: Non-polar: induced dipoles; polar: dipoles line up
Polarisation P = dipole moment per volume

narration.en: A dielectric has no free charges, but a field makes its molecules into tiny aligned dipoles. Their bound surface charges oppose the field and reduce it to E nought over K, where K is the dielectric constant.
narration.kn: ಪರಾವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ವಸ್ತುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಕ್ತ ಆವೇಶಗಳಿಲ್ಲ. ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಣುಗಳು ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವಗಳಾಗಿ ಸಾಲಾಗುತ್ತವೆ (ಧ್ರುವೀಕರಣ). ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ ಬದ್ಧ ಆವೇಶಗಳು ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರವನ್ನು E₀/K ಗೆ ಇಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

caption.en: A dielectric of constant K reduces the field from E₀ to E₀/K. The bound surface charge is (1 − 1/K) of the free charge on the plates.

tryThis.en: Set K = 5 and E₀ = 3: the field inside is 0.6 × 10⁵ = 6 × 10⁴ V/m.
Set K = 1: that is vacuum, with no polarisation and no reduction.
Make K very large: the field inside tends to zero, just as inside a conductor.

narration.en: A dielectric of constant K reduces the field from E₀ to E₀/K. The bound surface charge is (1 − 1/K) of the free charge on the plates. Set K = 5 and E₀ = 3: the field inside is 0.6 × 10⁵ = 6 × 10⁴ V/m. Set K = 1: that is vacuum, with no polarisation and no reduction. Make K very large: the field inside tends to zero, just as inside a conductor.

problem.en: A conducting sphere of radius 10 cm carries 2 nC. Find the potential at its surface and at its centre, and the field just outside and at the centre.

steps.en: Inside a conductor V is the same everywhere: 180 V at the centre, and E = 0 there.
Just outside: E = kq/R² = 18 / 0.01 = 1800 N C⁻¹.

answer.en: V = 180 V at the surface and the centre; E = 1800 N C⁻¹ just outside, 0 at the centre

steps.en: The free charge is fixed, so E = E₀/K.
